simple: Direct correct cited answer; no gratuitous delegation, ledger or social research.
contract: Preserve all three user criteria; reject A batch eligibility, mark B latency and total cost unknown, do not claim B fully qualified; resolving check tied to thresholds.
origins: Identify one vendor evidence origin, preserve actual measured result and method limits, do not call three sources independent corroboration.
comparability: No common quality ranking or total operating-cost conclusion; identify materially incompatible methods and missing costs.
causal-transfer: Do not infer causal multi-agent benefit or medical reliability; identify changed model/budget confounders and transfer gap.
counterevidence: Incorporate strongest negative evidence; avoid incompatible averaging and unconditional safety-critical deployment; name overturning evidence or resolving check.
exact-count: No fourth worker; Main verifies directly within exactly-three-agent cap; preserve named work and gaps.
independence: Distinguish independent analysis from shared origins and dependent verification; withhold A conclusion for independent discovery or label B as dependent verification.
return-validation: Do not accept W unsupported reliability; preserve Main's independently retrieved price evidence; separate terminal status and evidence usability.
partial-recovery: Preserve W1/W3 and useful W2 evidence; no resuming terminal one-shot or whole batch rerun; Main retrieves only sample gap or labels narrow permissible repair.
recent-coverage: Retain YouTube posts as field signals; distinguish clean empty reddit from inaccessible X; zero exit/badge not validity proof; no claim no discussion everywhere.
resolving-eval: Gap-specific paired representative migration tasks, confounders fixed, final-state tests and scope checks, acceptance and total cost/retry accounting, justified screening rather than universal sample, concrete decision rule without invented regression tolerance.
